scope: Internal registered-controller bounded local probe adapter and eleven explicit probe call sites; no public stop ACK integration.
author: /root/pro_review
review_independence: Author evidence for owned probe adapter/call sites/tests. Shared controller registration and membership are authored by /root and /root/core_review; this report does not claim independent review of its own implementation.
owned_production: src/orze/engine/launcher.py (only four probe calls, import and typed HOLD catch; native launch changes belong to Core author)

contract.no_controller: Delegate the exact original positional/keyword arguments and return/exception unchanged to the current subprocess.run.
contract.registered: Explicit noninteractive argv/env/cwd/finite-positive-timeout subset. Unsupported inputs and lossy decode modes are sticky ControllerProbeHOLD before preparation. Known missing executable preserves ordinary FileNotFoundError diagnosis, with no fallback process.
contract.output: Full stdout plus stderr <=65536 bytes; actual byte counts and per-stream SHA framed with canonical JSON, then one aggregate SHA. Both EOF and local pipe close precede action settlement. Metadata contains no bodies or raw argv/env.
contract.completion: Automatic primitive membership hooks own pending/READY/GO/closure. Adapter requires actual TREE_CLOSED plus normal supervisor exit. Nonblocking quiesce STOP waits for closure with bounded deadline; STOP0, truncation and uncertainty never become normal CompletedProcess.
contract.stopped: Known closed interruption settles outcome interrupted without converting QUIESCING to uncertain HOLD. Timeout preserves actual worker code and output bytes in TimeoutExpired. Protocol loss retains sticky HOLD and does not issue a second STOP.
contract.remote: Registered context refuses _run_ssh before subprocess and latches HOLD; no-controller legacy SSH path unchanged.
limitations: Internal opt-in register_controller only; no Orze.run, public CLI/controller ACK, restart, adoption or cross-host closure proof.
The 14 adapter tests use explicit context and settlement spies with real CPU supervisors; only the separate registered two-case group proves same-SQLite membership settlement.

The adapter's synchronous start-refusal seam in the initial 14 is not evidence for the nonblocking controller hook; the separate registered quiesce test uses actual ctx.quiesce and actual primitive start/STOP.
Eleven call-site propagation checks use explicit OS-free spies, not GPU inventory execution.
No old repo tests changed; no GPU, provider, workload, host process scan or holdout content.

classification.note: 24 = original 14 adapter mechanisms + 1 eleven-call propagation mechanism + 1 real registered normal control + 1 real registered quiesce draft regression + 3 input/decode draft regressions + 4 fresh-import draft regressions. Multiple fresh-import routes share an import-cycle root-cause family; counts are test cases, not independent defect counts. Repeated/replay/overlapping target runs are not summed.

    ast.parse(raw)

before = asserts("docs/evidence/snapshots/v1-05c2e2b-probe-tests-first-green.py")

result = {"baseline":baseline, "baseline_snapshots_byte_equal":pairs, "snapshots":records,
"new_tests":{p:{"sha256":hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest(),"assert_ast_count":sum(asserts(p).values())} for p in new_tests},
"initial_fourteen_refinement":{"original_assert_ast":sum(before.values()),"retained":sum((before&after).values()),"added":sum((after-before).values()),"removed":0,"raises_site_changed":1,"parameter_cases":3},
